suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Công nghệ & Dữ liệu Nông nghiệp
suggestions.reasoning: Grounded in Stanford HAI (2024) and McKinsey (2023) research regarding AI augmentation in data-driven sectors, this path combines your 15 years of agricultural experience in Can Tho with modern precision farming technologies. While AI automates routine tasks, your deep domain contextualization and local market understanding in the Mekong Delta remain irreplaceable human advantages.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your strengths in being open to new technology and understanding local farming markets align seamlessly with the shift toward precision agriculture. Even without advanced data analysis skills or English proficiency, your hands-on experience with drones and farm management serves as a robust foundation to transition into an advisory or technical support role.
